Eco-conscious and reusable, Skoy Cloths are designed as a healthy replacement for sponges and paper towels.
Skoy Cloths are made in Germany from a unique combination of cotton and wood pulp cellulose harvested from sustainable forests.
Good clean fun includes eleven designs in assorted colors

Reusable, absorbs 15 times own weight. The Skoy Cloth is a environment-friendly, chlorine-free and unbleached cleaning cloth that will outlast 15 rolls of paper towel! It is made using water-based colors and ink.
A single Skoy Cloth can outlast 15 paper towel rolls.
Two moms revolutionize kitchen cleaning - just for skoj*
Michelle Lundqvist and Karen Petersen launched Skoy in sunny Encinitas, California with the introduction of the Skoy Cloth in 2007.
It was the first in a line of indispensable Skoy products designed to outlast and outperform traditional and disposable alternatives - in style.
Skoy products combine unique materials and vibrant designs for refreshingly colorful and eco-conscious approach to everyday cleaning.
* Skoj: Pronounced Skoy is Swedish for fun!
